description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

Pushes monitoring data (external data) for a given running test.

Resolution limitation:
  • Maximum resolution for a monitor value is 1 per second, otherwise the first value is kept.
Maximum paths and monitors:
  • Maximum 100 different unique paths.
  • Maximum 50 different monitors for a given path.
  • Maximum length is 10 for a path.
Other requirements:
  • '/' character is not allowed in path element.
  • The test must be running while pushing the data.
  • For a given timestamp, all monitors relative to a path must be sent in the same request.
  • These elements must not be empty: monitor name, a path element and values.
